mentions.name: EasyEnv
mentions.description: A technical interview service that provisions a real production environment for candidates, who can work with agents while the system reports to the interviewer on how the candidate actually performed. The environment supports full clusters with Kubernetes, Docker, or plain Linux, including a database and various dependencies.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m working on a technical interview service that brings up a real production environment and also lets users use agents and our system tells the interviewer how the candidate really did.

Also, in this environment, users can have a full cluster with Kubernetes, Docker, or normal Linux, with a database and all sorts of dependencies.
